entry_schema.identity: Declaration Validation Characterization Entry schema version 1

NORMATIVE_CANDIDATE_OBLIGATION.semantic_role: A candidate requirement on the pinned modeled declaration-validity judgment. Its kind does not imply that normative authority has been established.
NORMATIVE_CANDIDATE_OBLIGATION.promotion_rule: An empirical scenario may be represented separately as a normative candidate only through an auditable research decision supported by normative evidence; changing kind in place is forbidden.
not_equivalent_to: a mutation operator or mutant identity

EMPIRICAL_CONTRACT_SCENARIO.semantic_role: A precisely characterized observable boundary whose interpretation may depend on serialization, reconstruction, policy, completeness, version, configuration, or an unresolved specification choice.
EMPIRICAL_CONTRACT_SCENARIO.promotion_rule: No observation count, checker agreement, designated-reference outcome, or LLM judgment promotes this object into a normative candidate. A separate decision record and separately identified candidate are required.

values.definition: Behavior attributed to the pinned checked declaration-addition judgment, subject to per-entry authority qualification.
Requirements or observations about the serialized lean4export representation itself.
Treatment of serialized information during parsing, reconstruction, redundancy handling, or replay before or around kernel validation.
Acceptance or rejection induced by explicit trust, safety, axiom, or configuration policy rather than ordinary checked declaration validity alone.
A deliberate implementation constraint not established as a universal requirement of the pinned modeled judgment.

The entry's explicitly named authority scope satisfies an auditable qualification rule with no recorded unmet requirement. Established normative scope additionally requires NORMATIVE_SUPPORT; full family-specific sufficiency rules are deferred to Milestone 7.
Evidence supports a bounded candidate or scenario, but at least one named qualification requirement remains unmet.
Available evidence leaves the stated authority scope genuinely undecided or contradictory, with the blocking question preserved.
Current characterization object retained for the bounded study.
Replaced by one or more identified objects while retained for audit history.
Shown to be subsumed by one or more identified semantic objects while retained for audit history.
A valid discovered issue excluded from the frozen ordinary-declaration slice with an explicit reason.
Evidence establishes a direct connection to logical soundness for the stated scope.
Evidence establishes declaration-contract relevance but not a direct logical-soundness consequence.
The soundness consequence is materially uncertain and remains an explicit research question.
No soundness-relevance assessment has yet been attempted; rejection behavior must not fill this gap by inference.

roles.purpose: Supports a claim about the intended or formally modeled judgment under explicit assumptions.
may_establish: a normative premise within the precise scope stated by the source
a modeled rule when the source-to-target relationship and assumptions are qualified
does_not_establish: unqualified equivalence between a formal model and the pinned implementation
normativity merely because the source is official code

roles.purpose: Records exact behavior or enforcement in a pinned implementation or checker profile.
may_establish: that the pinned implementation contains an identified check
that a pinned checker accepted or rejected an exact input under an exact configuration
does_not_establish: independence from another implementation without lineage evidence

roles.purpose: Explains why a candidate or scenario entered the research surface.
may_establish: that the source contains a boundary requiring disposition

roles.purpose: Supports reach, infection, target-predicate violation, or separation from competing predicates for a bounded artifact pair or experiment.
may_establish: reach or infection under the recorded experiment
absence of named competing violations within the audit scope
does_not_establish: general absence of all competing obligations

roles.purpose: Records evidence that conflicts with an authority claim, layer assignment, interpretation, or observer attribution.
may_establish: that a claimed interpretation is not supported uniformly
that an unresolved state or narrower scope is required
does_not_establish: which competing interpretation is correct by itself

roles.purpose: Binds a positive, negative, environmental, or procedural control used to interpret another evidence item.
may_establish: that the observer or path was operational under the recorded conditions
does_not_establish: target-predicate isolation without a competing-obligation analysis

source_types.definition: A pinned theorem or definition checked in a proof assistant, with assumptions and its relation to the target judgment recorded.
A source explicitly designated as specifying the relevant modeled judgment.
Official documentation that states intended behavior; explanatory and normative passages must remain distinguishable in the locator and claim.
Pinned source code that establishes implementation behavior, enforcement, reconstruction, or policy.
A content-bound execution result for a pinned checker profile.
A mutation experiment establishing a bounded reach, infection, or differential property.
A content-addressed positive or negative serialized artifact used to expose a boundary.
A pinned Lean Kernel Arena case or test expectation, which establishes Arena intent rather than normativity by itself.
A reproducible Lean Assurance Lab investigation, matrix, remap audit, or control experiment.
A content-addressed serialized stream or export metadata record.
An explicitly qualified source not covered by another type; it cannot serve as NORMATIVE_SUPPORT without extending this model.

mechanized_result_requirements: relationship to the pinned modeled declaration judgment
check command or an explicit reason it is not yet recorded

calibration_inputs.use: Adversarial calibration that previously demonstrated both kinds and the need to decompose stateful isUnsafe behavior.
calibration_inputs.prohibition: Its six prototype claims are not imported as declaration-validation catalog entries and do not establish normative authority.

calibration_inputs.use: Documents the smallest two-kind model tested against the previous representative set and its known limitations.
calibration_inputs.prohibition: Explanatory prose does not become evidence for a future entry unless separately locked and role-qualified.

calibration_inputs.use: Provides prior merge/split and layer-calibration pressure, including reconstruction and policy boundaries.
calibration_inputs.prohibition: The prior factored set is not a discovery closure or a denominator for the new ordinary-declaration slice.

invariants: Every characterization entry has exactly one of the two kinds; no universal catch-all object exists.
Kind, layers, authority, lifecycle, and soundness relevance are orthogonal axes.
Layers are a nonempty set, so one scenario may span serialization, reconstruction, policy, and kernel observation without forced collapse.
POLICY and RECONSTRUCTION are layer concepts and cannot appear as authority or lifecycle states.
Free-form confidence is forbidden; authority is justified only through an explicit qualification rule, bound evidence, and unmet requirements.
An ESTABLISHED normative candidate requires at least one role-qualified NORMATIVE_SUPPORT item; implementation agreement cannot substitute for it.
Every evidence item names its role, source type, source lock, exact locator, structured claim, and assumptions.
Evidence roles qualify distinct propositions and are never converted into a one-dimensional rank.
Implementation-source, checker-result, and formal-mechanization evidence records carry explicit lineage information.
A mechanized result records its exact theorem or definition, assumptions or axioms, target-judgment relationship, and check command or missing-command reason.
Lean4Lean observations are classified as derived from the official C++ kernel and are not independent votes.
No checker count, majority, or consensus establishes normativity.
Unknown authority, interpretation, or soundness relevance remains explicit rather than being inferred from rejection behavior.
Schema conformance alone establishes representability, not the truth or authority of an entry.
nonclaims: No declaration-validation candidate obligation or empirical scenario has been entered into a canonical catalog.
No rule is established merely because the entry schema can represent it.
No evidence role is a rank, score, confidence value, or semantic vote.
No official implementation check has been promoted to a normative requirement.
No checker agreement or majority has been used as a semantic oracle.
No Lean4Lean result is cited as mechanized normative support by this milestone.
No discovery source boundary has been frozen or inspected under Milestone 4 methodology.
No source-lock registry, candidate inventory, Arena coverage denominator, or negative-witness campaign has been created.
